intention: Users can manually log home/work/3rd-party charge sessions (date, energy, COP cost + optional battery/timing/type/location) that the Fleet API cannot attribute — the user-asserted complement to RM2's Supercharger sessions.
request: ok, let's go for a manual entry approach. Looks like this might be a big roadmap since it touches front-end pages with HTMX. I want this approach lives in its own package/module isolated of the other ones. It does not consumes any tesla's fleet api, right? Please help me to create the openspec proposal for this new module package , and separate the task/roadmap tiers by frontend and backend changes. Help me to design the database table, I'd say that required fields might be:  Date, price (COP), energy added. and as optional fields: Start timestamp, end timestamp, starting battery %, ending battery %, charging type (AC, DC), if it's HOME, WORK or OTHER. any suggestion are welcome

decisions.decision: Feature is a new isolated module internal/manualcharge (table manual_charge_entries, type manualcharge.Entry, Writer CRUD + Reader ports) consuming NO Tesla Fleet API; required fields charged_on/energy_added_kwh/price+currency('COP'); optional timing, battery %, charging_type(AC|DC), location_kind(HOME|WORK|OTHER)/label, notes; mutable table.
decisions.why: Wall Connector energy API is charger-centric and un-attributable per-vehicle in a multi-tenant platform (declined 2026-07-18); manual entry makes the user assert ownership.

decisions.decision: Autopilot ON; tiers advance automatically. Frontend must live in gateway (no HTML outside gateway), so tier 2 is a gateway change, not a second file in the new module.
decisions.why: Roadmap default is autopilot; architecture rule forces the htmx page into gateway consuming the manualcharge ports.

decisions.decision: Tier-2 UI product choices (leader interview): (a) standalone /charges 'Charge log' page linked from dashboard nav, NOT a dashboard section; (b) inline row edit via htmx (Edit swaps the row into an edit form, Save/Cancel swaps back), NOT a separate edit page; (c) form shows the 3 required fields (charged_on, energy_added_kwh, price) with the ~8 optional fields under a 'More details' expander.
decisions.why: User-selected in the Step-2 interview; binding for the RM3-gateway-add-manual-charge-ui proposal/design/specs.

decisions.decision: Gateway 'read-only at request time' rule (internal/gateway/AGENTS.md) is amended to permit user-initiated domain WRITES via a module Writer port on explicit form POSTs: CSRF-protected and tenant-scoped (account_id + vehicle resolved from the user's own account.RegisteredVehicles before calling manualcharge.Writer). Reads still use Reader ports only. This is the first user-facing domain write path in the gateway.
decisions.why: Roadmap D1/D2 already decided the gateway calls the manualcharge Writer (CRUD) from the UI; the AGENTS.md read-only rule predates any user write and must be reconciled. Direction is user-chosen, so no autopilot pause; recorded for the reviewer who reads AGENTS.md.

decisions.decision: A full grill-me pass was not run for tier 2; the Step-2 leader interview (3 targeted product forks, all resolved) satisfies the clarification pass. No database/index design (tier 2 adds no DB objects and reuses tier-1 manualcharge ports/queries), so the performance-design grill trigger does not fire.
decisions.why: Pipeline guidance: don't grill when the answer is genuinely obvious; the design space is small and already fixed by roadmap D1/D2 + the interview. Recorded for transparency per config.yaml proposal rule.

budget.note: sum of wave-1 (1.96), wave-2+verify (3.37), review round-1 (1.34); spanned a 5-hour bucket reset between wave 1 and wave 2 (checkpoint/clear/resume)

tiers.notes: New isolated internal/manualcharge module: table + 2 indexes, sqlc, Entry + derived methods, Writer/Reader ports, service, 28 tests (8 unit + 20 integration) green vs real Postgres. Reviewer-approved round 1 (3 minor findings: 2 fixed, R3 to backlog).
Step-2 interview done (D3 product forks, D4 write-path amendment, D5 grill note). Dispatching gateway worker for OpenSpec artifacts (spec delta on the gateway capability).
